n:SetIntensity(value) end,
                SetSoundEnabled = function(value) ShaderRain:SetSoundEnabled(value) end,
                SetSoundVolume = function(value) ShaderRain:SetSoundVolume(value) end,
                SetRespectShelter = function(value) ShaderRain:SetRespectShelter(value) end,
                SetStormEnabled = function(value) ShaderRain:SetStormEnabled(value) end,
                IsEnabled = function() return ShaderRain.Enabled end,
            },
            Restore = shaderRestoreImmersive,
        },
    }

    end

    Window:InitializeShaderSystem()

    local ChatApi = nil -- chat global v14 (se crea más abajo, en la pestaña Chat)

    local AutoTabAjustes = Window:CreateTab("Ajustes", "Settings", "rbxassetid://98148562257039")

        Window,

            return SlidersHidden
        end,

            SlidersHidden = value
        end,

            if ChatApi then return ChatApi.GetSideNotifs() end
            return SavedConfig.ChatCornerMessages ~= false
        end,
        function(value)
            -- "Mensajes del Chat en esquina" = avisos al costado del chat v14
            if ChatApi then ChatApi.SetSideNotifs(value) end
        end
    )

    -- ===== CHAT GLOBAL (opcional) =====
    function Window:CreateChatTab()
    if self.ChatTab and self.ChatTab.Page and self.ChatTab.Page.Parent then
        return self.ChatTab
    end
    local ChatTab = Window:CreateTab("Chat", "Chat", "rbxassetid://82910060656954")
    self.ChatTab = ChatTab
    local ChatTabPage = ChatTab.Page
    ChatTabPage.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    ChatTabPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
    ChatTabPage.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    ChatTabPage.ScrollingEnabled = false

    local ChatHost = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = ChatTabPage,
        Name = "ChatGlobalHost",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        ZIndex = 9,
    })
    -- v15: los colores/efectos de texto de la librería no tocan el chat global
    Window._ThemeIsolatedRoot = ChatHost
    if Window._InvalidateTextObjects then Window._InvalidateTextObjects() end

    -- globo de no leídos en el botón de la pestaña
    local ChatBadge = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = ChatTab.Button,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 55),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 20,
    })
    corner(ChatBadge, 999)
    local ChatBadgeLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = ChatBadge,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "0",
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 10,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        ZIndex = 21,
    })
    local lastBadge = 0
    local function setChatBadge(total)
        total = tonumber(total) or 0
        ChatBadge.Visible = total > 0
        if total > 0 then
            ChatBadgeLabel.Text = total > 99 and "99+" or tostring(total)
            if total > lastBadge then
                ChatBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
                TweenService:Create(ChatBadge, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18) }):Play()
            end
        end
        lastBadge = total
    end

    local okChat, chatResult = pcall(YinYang._BuildChatGlobal, {
        Host = ChatHost,
        Glass = function(parent)
            local image = mk("ImageLabel", {Name = "ChatGlass", Parent = parent,
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageTransparency = 0.35, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, ZIndex = parent.ZIndex})
            corner(image, 18)
            YinIcons.get("spotify-glass", function(asset) if image.Parent then image.Image = asset end end)
        end,
        OverlayParent = ScreenGui.Parent,
        OnlineLabel = TopBarOnlineLabel,
        SetBadge = setChatBadge,
        Open = function()
            pcall(function() Window:Show() end)
            if ChatTab.Select then ChatTab.Select() end
        end,
    })
    if okChat and type(chatResult) == "table" then
        ChatApi = chatResult
        local spotify = Window._SpotifyAmbient
        if spotify and spotify.Active and spotify.Saved and spotify.Saved.visible then
            spotify.Saved.visible[TopBarCounter] = true
        else
            TopBarCounter.Visible = true
        end
        if SavedConfig.ChatCornerMessages == false then
            pcall(ChatApi.SetSideNotifs, false)
        end
        ScreenGui.Destroying:Connect(function() pcall(ChatApi.Destroy) end)
    else
        warn("[ChatGlobal] No se pudo iniciar el chat: " .. tostring(chatResult))
    end

    -- Vista inmersiva del chat: un único fondo del tema cubre toda la ventana.
    do
        local A = {Active = false}
        Window._ChatAmbient = A
        local shade = mk("Frame", {Name = "ChatAmbientShade", Parent = Main,
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 7, 11),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.48, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 6})
        corner(shade, 10)
        function A.Layout()
            if not A.Active then return end
            local compact = Window.CompactNavigation == true
            local side = compact and 58 or 110
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, side, 0, -56)
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -side, 1, 56)
            TabListArt.Visible = false
            CatImage.Visible = false
            local rail = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactTabRail")
            if rail then rail.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
            if ChatApi and ChatApi.SetHeaderInset then ChatApi.SetHeaderInset(compact and 66 or 0) end
        end
        function A.enter()
            if A.Active then return end
            A.Active = true
            A.saved = {visible = {}, top = TopBar.BackgroundTransparency,
                tabs = TabList.BackgroundTransparency, titleSize = TitleLabel.Size,
                titleZ = TitleLabel.ZIndex, badgeZ = DaraHubLabel.ZIndex,
                badgeFrameZ = DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex}
            for _, obj in ipairs({BannerFrame, BoomboxPill, WindowControls, TopBarCounter,
                TitleDivider, TopBarArt, TabListArt, CatImage, Main:FindFirstChild("RotatingSubText")}) do
                if obj then A.saved.visible[obj] = obj.Visible; obj.Visible = false end
            end
            BackgroundArt.Parent = Main
            BackgroundArt.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            BackgroundArt.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            BackgroundArt.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            shade.Visible = true
            TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TabList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(106, 26)
            TitleLabel.ZIndex = 60
            DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex = 60
            DaraHubLabel.ZIndex = 61
            A.Layout()
        end
        function A.leave()
            if not A.Active then return end
            A.Active = false
            shade.Visible = false
            for obj, visible in pairs(A.saved.visible or {}) do if obj.Parent then obj.Visible = visible end end
            Window._ApplyFullBackground()
            TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = A.saved.top
            TabList.BackgroundTransparency = A.saved.tabs
            TitleLabel.Size = A.saved.titleSize
            TitleLabel.ZIndex = A.saved.titleZ
            DaraHubLabel.ZIndex = A.saved.badgeZ
            DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex = A.saved.badgeFrameZ
            local compact = Window.CompactNavigation == true
            local side = compact and 58 or 110
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, side, 0, 0)
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -side, 1, 0)
            TabListArt.Visible = not compact
            CatImage.Visible = not compact and Theme.ThemeName == "Dark"
            local rail = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactTabRail")
            if rail then rail.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
            if ChatApi and ChatApi.SetHeaderInset then ChatApi.SetHeaderInset(0) end
        end
        track(ChatTabPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
            task.defer(function()
                if ChatTabPage.Parent then
                    if ChatTabPage.Visible then A.enter() else A.leave() end
                end
            end)
        end))
        if ChatTabPage.Visible then A.enter() end
    end
    return ChatTab
    end

    if options.Chat == true then Window:CreateChatTab() end

    RefreshLibraryLanguage = function()
        for _, el in ipairs(Window.ScreenGui:GetDescendants()) do
            if el:IsA("TextLabel") or el:IsA("TextButton") or el:IsA("TextBox") then
                local sp = el:GetAttribute("TextSpanish")
                local en = el:GetAttribute("TextEnglish")
                if sp and en then
                    el.Text = GetText(sp, en)
                end

                if el:IsA("TextBox") then
                    local psp = el:GetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish")
                    local pen = el:GetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish")
                    if psp and pen then
                        el.PlaceholderText = GetText(psp, pen)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local lastLanguage = LibraryLanguage
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if LibraryLanguage == lastLanguage then
            return
        end
        lastLanguage = LibraryLanguage
        RefreshLibraryLanguage()
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            task.wait(0.25)
            RefreshLibraryLanguage()
        end
    end)

        local label = mk("TextLabel", props)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            label.Text = GetText(es, en)

            label:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)

        if role then label:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", role) end
        return label
    end

    -- Las imágenes originales se descargan como assets locales cuando el entorno lo permite.
    local function socialCard(order, platform, displayName, handle, link, imageName, offset, dimensions)
        local c = card(order, 110)
        c.ClipsDescendants = true
        local portrait = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = "rbxassetid://125311226076728", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 11,
        })
        corner(portrait, 999)
        local border = mk("UIStroke", {Parent = portrait, Color = Theme.Stroke, Thickness = 1.4, Transparency = 0.18})
        border:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Stroke")
        local stripe = mk("Frame", {Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 13),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -26), BorderSizePixel = 0,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, ZIndex = 11})
        stripe:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(stripe, 4)
        local platformLabel = text({
            Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 10), Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 14),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            Text = platform, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
        }, nil, nil, "Accent")
        text({
            Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 25), Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 21),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Text = displayName, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
        }, nil, nil, "Text")
        text({
            Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 47), Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 17),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Text = handle, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
        }, nil, nil, "TextDim")
        local copy = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -37), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 26),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.85,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 12,
        })
        copy:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(copy, 8)
        local label = text({
            Parent = copy, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 13,
        }, "Copiar enlace", "Copy link", "Text")
        local serial = 0
        local address
        copy.Activated:Connect(function()
            local copied = type(setclipboard) == "function" and pcall(setclipboard, link)
            if not copied then
                copy.Visible = false
                address.Visible = true
                address:CaptureFocus()
                return
            end
            serial = serial + 1
            local this = serial
            label.Text = copied and GetText("✓ Enlace copiado", "✓ Link copied")
                or GetText("No se pudo copiar", "Could not copy")
            task.delay(2.5, function()
                if this == serial and copy.Parent then label.Text = GetText("Copiar enlace", "Copy link") end
            end)
        end)
        -- El enlace también queda disponible para selección manual sin portapapeles.
        address = mk("TextBox", {
            Parent = c, Name = platform .. "Link", Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -37),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 26), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            Text = link, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 10,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextEditable = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = 14,
        })
        corner(address, 8)
        address.FocusLost:Connect(function() address.Visible = false copy.Visible = true end)
        copy:SetAttribute("Link", link)
        task.spawn(function()
            if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return end
            local ok, asset = pcall(function()
                local localName = "YinCredits_" .. imageName
                if type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(localName) then
                    local data = game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YinScripts/Yin-UI/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/" .. imageName)
                    if type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 100 then return nil end
                    writefile(localName, data)
                end
                return getcustomasset(localName)
            end)
            if ok and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" and portrait.Parent then
                portrait.Image = asset
                portrait.ImageRectOffset = offset
                portrait.ImageRectSize = dimensions
            end
        end)
    end
    socialCard(5, "YOUTUBE", "Yin yang | New Script", "@Yin-Yang-Hub",
        "https://youtube.com/@yin-yang-hub?si=lX7-WkyujSdjX7i7", "credit-youtube.jpg",
        Vector2.new(42, 310), Vector2.new(188, 188))

            if mine ~= copyToken or not CopyBtn.Parent then return end

    local function BuildLogoTab()
    local TabLogo = Window:CreateTab("Logo", "Logo", "rbxassetid://102470093365848")
    local LogoPage = TabLogo.Page

    LogoPage.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    LogoPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    LogoPage.ScrollBarThickness = 2
    LogoPage.ScrollingEnabled = true

    mk("UIPadding", {
        Parent       = LogoPage,
        PaddingTop   = UDim.new(0, 10),
        PaddingLeft  = UDim.new(0, 10),
        PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
        PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
    })
    mk("UIListLayout", {
        Parent            = LogoPage,
        Padding           = UDim.new(0, 8),
        SortOrder         = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        FillDirection     = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
        HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
    })

    -- Cabecera: el icono en uso, en grande
    local LP = {cards = {}}
    LP.hero = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = LogoPage,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 104),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        LayoutOrder = 0,
        ZIndex = 11,
    })
    LP.hero:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
    corner(LP.hero, 16)
    stroke(LP.hero, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.55)
    mk("UIGradient", {
        Parent = LP.hero,
        Rotation = 0,
        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.5)}),
    })
    LP.stage = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = LP.hero,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -40),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 12,
    })
    LP.stage:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    corner(LP.stage, 999)
    local heroRing = stroke(LP.stage, Theme.Accent, 2.5, 0)
    heroRing:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
    LP.caption = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = LP.hero,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 12),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 108, 0, 24),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = GetText("ÍCONO FLOTANTE EN USO", "FLOATING ICON IN USE"),
        TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        TextSize = 9,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 12,
    })
    LP.caption:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
    LP.caption:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "ÍCONO FLOTANTE EN USO")
    LP.caption:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "FLOATING ICON IN USE")
    LP.name = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = LP.hero,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 24),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 108, 0, 38),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",

        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,

    LP.name:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    LP.hint = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = LP.hero,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 14),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 108, 0, 64),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = GetText("Tocá un ícono para usarlo · se guarda solo", "Tap an icon to use it · saved automatically"),
        TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextSize = 10,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        ZIndex = 12,
    })
    LP.hint:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
    LP.hint:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Tocá un ícono para usarlo · se guarda solo")
    LP.hint:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Tap an icon to use it · saved automatically")

    local function LP_Preview(parent, iconData, px, z)
        local layer = iconData and iconData.Layers and iconData.Layers[1]
        if not layer then return end
        local size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px)
        local pos = UDim2.new(0.5, -px / 2, 0.5, -px / 2)
        if type(layer.SpriteSheet) == "table" then
            createSpriteSheetLabels(parent, layer.SpriteSheet, size, pos, z)
        elseif layer.Image then
            mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = parent, Size = size, Position = pos, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = layer.Image, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = z,
            })
        end
    end

    function LP.setHero(iconName)
        for _, ch in ipairs(LP.stage:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("ImageLabel") or ch.Name == "LogoComposite" then ch:Destroy() end
        end
        local data = IconCatalog.Icons[iconName]
        if data and data.Custom and LP.composite then
            LP.composite(LP.stage, data, 74, 13)
        else
            LP_Preview(LP.stage, data, 60, 13)
        end
        LP.name.Text = data and GetText(data.LabelES or iconName, data.LabelEN or data.LabelES or iconName) or tostring(iconName or "")
    end

    local LP_Grid = mk("Frame", {
        Parent               = LogoPage,
        Size                 = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize        = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel      = 0,
        LayoutOrder          = 10,
    })
    mk("UIGridLayout", {
        Parent             = LP_Grid,
        CellSize           = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 118),
        CellPadding        = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8),
        SortOrder          = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
    })

    function LP.paint(entry, sel, animate)
        local info = TweenInfo.new(animate and 0.22 or 0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        TweenService:Create(entry.stroke, info, {Transparency = sel and 0 or 0.6, Thickness = sel and 2 or 1}):Play()
        entry.stroke.Color = sel and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
        entry.stroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", sel and "Accent" or "Stroke")
        entry.ring.Color = sel and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
        entry.ring.Transparency = sel and 0 or 0.7
        entry.ring:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", sel and "Accent" or "Stroke")
        entry.badge.Visible = sel
        entry.card.BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0.15 or 0.4
        entry.name.TextColor3 = sel and Theme.Accent or Theme.Text
        entry.name:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", sel and "Accent" or "Text")
    end

    local function CreateIconCard(iconName, iconData, order)
        local card = mk("Frame", {
            Parent               = LP_Grid,
            BackgroundColor3     = Theme.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
            BorderSizePixel      = 0,
            LayoutOrder          = order or 1,
            ZIndex               = 12,
        })
        corner(card, 14)
        local cardStroke = stroke(card, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
        card:SetAttribute("IconName", iconName)
        card:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        local cardScale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = card, Scale = 1})

        local stage = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = card,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 62),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 13,
        })
        stage:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        corner(stage, 999)
        local ring = stroke(stage, Theme.Stroke, 2, 0.7)
        LP_Preview(stage, iconData, 44, 14)

        local nameLbl = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent               = card,
            Size                 = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30),
            Position             = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 78),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text                 = GetText(iconData.LabelES or iconName, iconData.LabelEN or iconData.LabelES or iconName),
            TextColor3           = Theme.Text,
            TextSize             = 11,
            Font                 = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextXAlignment       = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            TextYAlignment       = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
            TextWrapped          = true,
            TextTruncate         = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex               = 14,
        })
        nameLbl:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")

        local badge = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = card,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 6),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            Text = "",
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 15,
        })
        badge:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(badge, 999)
        RowKit.Icon(badge, 103456899356871, 12, 16, "AccentText")

        local btn = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent               = card,
            Size                 = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text                 = "",
            ZIndex               = 16,
        })

        local entry = {card = card, stroke = cardStroke, ring = ring, badge = badge, name = nameLbl, key = iconName}
        LP.cards[#LP.cards + 1] = entry
        LP.paint(entry, SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon == iconName, false)

        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(cardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1.04}):Play()
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(cardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
        end)
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            cardScale.Scale = 0.93
            TweenService:Create(cardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon = iconName
            SaveConfig()
            ApplyLogoIcon(iconName)
            for _, other in ipairs(LP.cards) do
                LP.paint(other, other.key == iconName, true)
            end
            LP.setHero(iconName)
        end)

        return card
    end

    -- ==================== ESTUDIO DE LOGOS (crear logos flotantes propios) ====================
    -- Usa IconCatalog.Custom (arriba) para guardar y ApplyLogoIcon para dibujar el botón real.
    local function BuildLogoStudio()
    local CL = IconCatalog.Custom
    if not CL then return end

    local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local Z = 280 -- capa base del editor (por encima del creador de temas: 200-265)
    local LS = { live = {}, realLive = false, zoom = 1, backdrop = "day" }

    local MOVES = {
        { "None", "Quieto", "Still" },
        { "Spin", "Girar", "Spin" },
        { "Pulse", "Latir", "Pulse" },
        { "Orbit", "Órbita", "Orbit" },
        { "Float", "Flotar", "Float" },
        { "Shake", "Temblar", "Shake" },
        { "Fade", "Parpadeo", "Fade" },
    }
    -- rango de Speed / Amount por movimiento (mismos significados que el catálogo Yin-logos)
    local MOVE_INFO = {
        None = {},
        Spin = { speed = { 10, 600, 5, 60, "°/s", "Velocidad de giro", "Spin speed" }, dir = true, style = true },
        Pulse = { speed = { 0.3, 4, 0.1, 1.2, "s", "Duración del latido", "Beat duration" }, amount = { 2, 40, 1, 12, "%", "Cuánto crece", "Grow amount" } },
        Orbit = { speed = { 10, 360, 5, 40, "°/s", "Velocidad de órbita", "Orbit speed" }, amount = { 1, 20, 1, 6, "px", "Radio de la órbita", "Orbit radius" }, dir = true },
        Float = { speed = { 0.5, 6, 0.1, 2, "s", "Duración sube-baja", "Up-down duration" }, amount = { 1, 14, 1, 4, "px", "Distancia", "Distance" } },
        Shake = { speed = { 2, 30, 1, 12, "/s", "Vibraciones por segundo", "Shakes per second" }, amount = { 0.5, 8, 0.5, 2, "px", "Intensidad", "Intensity" } },
        Fade = { speed = { 0.4, 5, 0.1, 1.5, "s", "Duración del parpadeo", "Fade duration" }, amount = { 0.1, 1, 0.05, 0.6, "", "Transparencia máxima", "Max transparency" } },
    }

    -- ---------- helpers de UI ----------
    local function L(obj, es, en)
        obj:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
        obj:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
        obj.Text = GetText(es, en)
        return obj
    end
    local function label(parent, es, en, size, font, role, props)
        local t = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = parent,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextColor3 = Theme[role or "Text"] or Theme.Text,
            TextSize = size,
            Font = font,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = Z + 3,
        })
        t:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", role or "Text")
        if role and role ~= "Text" then t:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true) end
        L(t, es, en)
        for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do t[k] = v end
        return t
    end
    local function button(parent, es, en, role, props)
        local b = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = parent,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme[role] or Theme.Secondary,
